label: Groundwater drought indicator (GRACE-DA percentile) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
colormap: continuous red -> white -> green (red = low / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = high / increase); symmetric about 0, fixed across years
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: NASA GRACE-DA global drought indicator (gws_inst) via nasagrace.unl.edu
basis: annual mean (Jan-Dec) of the monthly values (weekly groundwater percentiles averaged by month, then by year). Missing months are filled by the climatology-anomaly method (yearly = mean monthly climatology + mean anomaly of the observed months); a year needs >= half of the season observed unless stated otherwise.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in percentile points/yr. Continuous colour: red = decrease, white = no change, green = increase (bilinear smoothing between cells; black hatching = data but too few years for a slope). No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
smoothing: slopes averaged onto the native 0.25° cells, then bilinear interpolation to the display pixels
